snippet.title: Red Alert 3 - Premier Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
The Red Alert 3 Premier Edition is the quintessential collectors edition every C&C comrade will want. Not only does it come in a limited edition tin, but you will also get five exclusive multiplayer maps, the official game soundtrack featuring the all-new Hell March 3, a bonus DVD with way too many star-studded features to list here, and an exclusive Beta Key to a future C&C game (start the rumor train)!

And let's not forget, MMO fans, the Premier Edition also unlocks a Red Alert 3-exclusive item for Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning! Your WOW friends will be jealous.

"les vrais fans de command & conquer vont sur http://www.cncsaga.com !"
